title: TimeSkeleton group file
description: A TimeSkeleton 0.7.0 group file: one timeline group and the timelines it names, self-contained. A group is an array of member timelines that share, by definition, the same graphical start and end: every member's 0 coincides with every other member's 0 and every member's length with every other member's length, and positions in between convert linearly. When only part of a timeline takes part, the member is a child of that timeline, placed at its exact offset; a member is never placed partially. The group names its members by id; each id names a timeline of the file's timelines array, a root or a descendant at any depth, and every root contains at least one member. Timeline ids, roots and descendants alike, are unique across the file, and the group id differs from every timeline id; every other id is unique within its own timeline manifest, as in a timeline file. The timelines and the members are sorted by id in code-point order, and readers accept any order; the members' display order is presentation and lives in graphical.order. Object keys carry no order and are written sorted by code point.

timelines.description: The root timelines of the file, each a complete timeline manifest with all its descendants, sorted by id. Each one is a member or contains a member.

Group.description: A timeline group: member timelines sharing the same graphical start and end, named by id. The bundle document refers to this definition for its groups.

id.description: The group id, unique among the file's groups and different from every timeline id of the file.

name.description: Human-readable name, or null when none was given.

members.description: The ids of the member timelines, sorted by code point, each naming a timeline of the file's timelines array: a root or a descendant at any depth. The array may be empty.

MemberOrder.description: The display order of one group's members: a permutation of its members. It is never re-ordered by a writer.

GroupGraphical.description: The presentation of the group file: the display order of its members, and named styles and statements with exactly the meaning they have in a timeline file's graphical block (`docs/drawing.md`, sections 2 and 8).

order.description: The display order of the group's members, a permutation of group.members. Without it, the members are displayed in the order of group.members.
